user.title: Add a ZEAL-Dry zone
user.description: Choose monitoring, the self-contained dummy test bench, or live climate control.

data_description.zone_name: A unique name for this area, for example ZEAL-Dry Test.
data_description.control_mode: Test / Dummy ACU creates adjustable temperature and humidity plus an internal dummy ACU. It cannot control real equipment.

sensors.title: Select indoor sensors
sensors.description: Choose the real Home Assistant sensors ZEAL-Dry should monitor.

dummy.title: Create ZEAL-Dry test bench
dummy.description: This creates adjustable Test temperature and Test humidity controls and a built-in Dummy ACU. Start at 18 °C and 55% RH, then raise humidity to test moisture demand safely.

climate.title: Select Dry-capable AC
climate.description: This zone will control this AC automatically after a ten-minute startup rest. Use equipment dedicated to ZEAL-Dry; other climate automations must not control it concurrently.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity is not currently available in Home Assistant.
error.zone_name_required: Enter a name for this ZEAL-Dry zone.
error.unsupported_climate: Select an available climate entity supporting Dry and Off modes.

abort.already_configured: A ZEAL-Dry zone with this name is already configured.

init.title: ZEAL-Dry options
init.description: Configure persistence, protection times and Dry temperature bounds. Changes are saved and applied to the controller. Live control observes a new rest period whenever the integration reloads.

error.invalid_settings: Check that minimum runtime and temperature do not exceed their maximum values.
